name: Weekly property listing sheet - 18 Lighthouse Point Road, Rockport, Maine 04856

values.Headline: A Point Estate at the End of the Reach
values.Description: Set at the very end of the reach on nearly four private acres, this shingle-and-stone point estate takes in open water on three sides, with two hundred and forty feet of owned shorefront, a deep-water dock rated for a forty-foot boat, and a protected mooring in the cove. Inside, five bedrooms and four and a half baths open to water from nearly every room, a chef's kitchen with two islands gives onto a glassed morning room, and the primary suite holds its own wing with a stone fireplace and a private balcony over the water. A carriage house, a heated gunite pool, mature gardens laid out by a noted landscape architect, and a gated drive complete a property that comes to this stretch of the mid coast perhaps once in a generation.
